⏱️ How Rest Timer Works

Suggested RPE values:
• Strength: Novice 8.0, Intermediate 8.5
• Build: Novice 7.5, Intermediate 8.0
• Flush: Novice 7.0, Intermediate 7.5
Timer Calculation:

1. Start with base rest time (Heavy/Light/Custom)
2. If RPE ≥ High Threshold: +Bonus seconds
3. If logged RPE ≥ suggested+threshold: +Positive adjustment
4. If logged RPE ≤ suggested-threshold: -Negative adjustment
Example: Strength intent, Intermediate, logged RPE 9.5\nBase: 180s + High RPE bonus (9.5≥9.0): +60s + Deviation (9.5-8.5=1.0): +30s = 270s total
